_note: Removed 2026-11-24 (code audit S23): w_space, w_skill, w_cost, w_red and space_threshold_cm, the influence formula's weights, carried into ds-orchestrator and read by nothing. Prototype, not calibrated. Weights per use (pressing, duel, receiver) are a later refinement; this is the first set. See L0-match/specs/03-entities-minimal.md §2.9. pressure_radius_cm and pressure_exit_milli (2026-11-12): an opponent puts the carrier under pressure when he comes within 5 m of the ball, and stays so until he is 30% farther (hysteresis). Before, the radius was space_threshold_cm (20 m) and there was no hysteresis: a match had 2,000-9,000 Pressure events (a real one has a few hundred), an opponent oscillating on the radius 'entered' again every tick. Arbitrary, declared, to be calibrated at L3.
